title: Odour-reward pairing: a dopamine-gated KC-to-MBON rule on the connectome, against fixed weights, a DAN lesion, a rewired connectome and the repository's mushroom-body rate model
preregistration: Written before any run of this file. The rule, its constants, the protocol and the criteria are ours, not fitted; the dev split may be run while the code changes, the held-out split once, on the reported commit.

rule.form: after each training trial, for every KC->MBON synapse (i, j): w_ij <- w_ij * (1 - eta * min(1, e_i / e_sat) * min(1, D_j / D_sat)), with e_i the KC's spikes in the trial and D_j the spikes of the PAM DANs that make at least 5 synapses onto MBON j (their output not silenced); weights never grow, never change sign
rule.basis: dopamine-induced depression of KC-to-MBON synapses paired with KC activity (Hige et al. 2015, Neuron 88:985-998, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2015.11.003; Cohn et al. 2015, Cell 163:1742-1755, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2015.11.019); PAM neurons carry reward (Liu et al. 2012, Nature 488:512-516, doi:10.1038/nature11304; Burke et al. 2012, Nature 492:433-437, doi:10.1038/nature11614). Which DAN reaches which MBON is read from the connectome (DAN-to-MBON synapses), standing in for the compartments the connectome's neuropil labels do not resolve.

odours.note: Abstract odours: the ORNs of three glomeruli each, both sides, at 80 Hz. No chemical identity or valence is claimed.

protocol.order: test A, B (x3 each, plasticity off); then 10 x (A with PAM DANs driven at 100 Hz, plasticity on; B alone, plasticity on); then test A, B again (x3 each, plasticity off)
protocol.readout: spikes of the MBONs that receive at least 5 synapses from some PAM DAN, summed over a test trial
protocol.learning_index: LI = A_after / A_before - B_after / B_before (negative: the paired odour's MBON response fell more)

echo_mb.what: The repository's mushroom-body rate model (src/bethesda/fly/mushroomBody/circuit.ts, Bennett, Philippides & Nowotny 2021), run by scripts/echo-neural-plasticity.ts on the same schedule: cue A rewarded with its meal reward, cue B unrewarded, 10 pairs; its prediction m+ - m- for each cue before and after. Its arms: the schedule as given, and the same schedule with the reward omitted (the model's learning rate cannot be set to 0: its range starts at 0.0125).

criteria.claim: The odours reach the readout: the PAM-innervated MBONs respond to each odour before training
criteria.threshold_note: ours: a precondition, not a learning result

criteria.claim: With the rule, the paired odour's MBON response falls more than the unpaired odour's
criteria.threshold_note: one-sided sign test over the 8 subjects (all 8 negative gives p = 1/256 = 0.0039)

criteria.claim: Blocking the DANs' output abolishes the learning
The repository's mushroom-body rate model learns the paired cue: its prediction for A rises above B's, and not when the reward is omitted
criteria.threshold_note: deterministic per subject; discriminate = after(A) - after(B) > 0.05 (ours, on the model's prediction scale where the meal reward is 1); every subject must with the reward and none without it

criteria.claim: Exploratory: the rule on a degree-preserving rewired connectome
